Annual generation: SEL 118 GWh vs IBE 2010 126 GWh.
Start of operation: SEL 1993, IBE 2010: construction completed 1993, use permit since 1997, 1988 news item planned completion Dec 1990.
OpenInfraMap summary 34 MW vs its generator table 3 x 14.4 = 43.2 MW (OSM tag confusion of MVA and MW).
Gross head: 8.1 m against 7.5 m in the JET 2024 paper.

blocks.name: Dam (outline from OpenStreetMap way 288155563)
info: OpenStreetMap way 288155563, waterway=dam, about 118 x 149 m

model_basis.assumed: The outline is drawn by OpenStreetMap mappers, not surveyed by the operator. It is raised as one block to the published height, starting at an assumed level 0, because the foundation and river bed elevations are not published. Gates, piers and the powerhouse interior are not drawn. The height of 27 m is the structural height given by SEL, the owner. IBE 2010 gives 25.65 m as an alternative design figure.
